state.prepare:
Workspace preparation before start (mandatory decision table; the skill has the full version):
1) Dirty workspace -> ask the user: [stop | auto commit (AI-generated message)]; free text from the user directs you instead — never lose uncommitted work.
2) Clean + on main/master -> no question: name the feature branch yourself (e.g. sfd/<slug>) and create it from main.
3) Clean + off main -> compute ahead/behind vs main, then offer the user exactly these options (always plus "stop"): 0/0 -> [stay | new branch from current]; ahead>0,behind=0 -> [stay | new from current | new from main (switch to main first) | fast-forward main to current, then stay]; ahead=0,behind>0 -> [stay | new from current | new from main (switch to main first) | fast-forward main to current, then branch from it]; ahead>0,behind>0 (diverged) -> [stay | new from current | new from main (switch to main first) | you merge with main, resolve all conflicts, and continue].
4) No main-like ref / detached HEAD / merge in progress -> ask the user how to proceed (always include "stop"); never guess a base.
Branch naming, creation, duplicate handling and any merge are your own git operations.
state.handoff: You now drive the start: first read the sectioned-feature-development skill, then determine the task to build. If this conversation has no task context yet, ask the user what they want before doing anything else. Once the task is known, perform workspace preparation per the decision table above and create the feature branch, then call the sfd_start tool with a one-line taskSummary (optional slug, branch) — it performs no git operations and no dispatch; it records the git facts it observes and creates the run ledger the plugin observes your external-subagent calls into.
state.nextPlan: Next: read the sectioned-feature-development skill, identify Feature(s) from the user request, and draft PLAN-FULL at .agent-work/PLAN-FULL.md. Dispatch reviewers yourself with the literal external_subagent_spawn(profile=…) rows from the skill's DSH dispatch profile.

state.legacyBody: This may be an uncleaned previous run or a pre-plugin run. Decide: archive it and start fresh, continue it manually, or stop. The plugin cannot resume a run it did not record.
state.readSkillFirst: Read the sectioned-feature-development skill first, then continue from the obligations above.

tool.finished: SFD run closed. The plugin stops injecting the [SFD] block.
tool.finishOpen: Actors not fully reconciled before closing: {ids} — reconcile them (result/close) per the skill; the ledger keeps them as evidence.
tool.finishArchive: Archive per the skill's artifact lifecycle (archive_plan.py) if you have not already.

obl.plan-coverage: - PLAN review A→B: two independent coverages must close before any implementer dispatch (observed dispatched {dispatched}, completed {done})
obl.plan-skip-warn: - WARNING: {impl} implementer(s) already dispatched while only {done} PLAN coverage(s) completed — the skill does not allow this; remediate (run the reviews) or state your justification
obl.freeze-before-review: - freeze the candidate (reconcile staged+unstaged+untracked) before Code A; B1 stays blind — no A findings or repair history in its prompt
obl.code-coverage: - after Code A closes: blind complete B1, then same-head B2; budget rulings (5 waves/section, plan 2 material waves) are the skill's (observed code-review dispatches: {dispatched})
